title: Having difficulty balancing a large scale game with just one player.
author: No_Departure7494
selftext:
The game is just a combat simulator I am working on. Lots of fun flying the planes, driving tanks, destroyers, etc.

The problem is that, for as engaging as it is - even though there's always something to shoot at - this is combined arms warfare. Meaning... One player will not turn the tide.

When it gets to that point, now I feel like the player is just sitting in a menu clicking on where his team should attack. Clicking points on a map and telling them to fire on that location.... but if this is the case you're no longer invested in driving the vehicles or anything because why would you be?

Is there any way to balance this?
